rows.en: Well, some days are just like that...

Hey, \p!
You just brushed that off because it's not
your problem, didn't you?
Oops, you noticed?
Geez, every last one of them...

(When you get down to it, Alto's
surprisingly chatty.)

(I'm supposed to meet Saotome-kun at "Silver Moon"
again today.)
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in locations.json.

rows.en: Well, some days are just like that...
Oops, you caught me?

(When you get down to it, Saotome-kun's
surprisingly chatty.)
(Today I'm going to the Artificial Island with Alto.)
rows.notes: Artificial Island as in the campus place list (u4335).

rows.en:
\p.
You're late.

Sorry, sorry, it took me a while to get ready...
Okay, let's get going!
rows.notes: Used 20 times in frd_alt_007, under both the player and Alto: the player's real greeting in the male scene; the other occurrences sit between Alto's montage reactions and look like filler entries. Written as the player's line, no gendered words.

rows.en: Phew, this is a pretty nice place.
Yeah, it feels great.

A beach and the ocean...
Hard to believe we're inside Frontier.

And there are lots of girls, too.
Look at that girl's swimsuit, for one...
rows.notes: Said by both the male and the female player (teasing Alto).

rows.en:
Huh? Uh...
Y-you idiot! Where are you looking?!

Geez, keep ogling girls like that
and you'll end up like Michel.
rows.notes: Mishieru here, so 'Michel' (the Silver Moon scene has Mihaeru, 'Michael').

rows.en: The ocean's nice once in a while~
Oh, that looks fun.
How can you eat something that gross?

I said, why do you keep hunting for girls
in swimsuits?!
Man, that really felt like a resort vacation.
Yeah. Hard to believe this place is out in space.
I'd love to come back sometime if we get the chance.
Yeah. Just don't spend the whole time chasing girls.
Ahaha, I'll be careful.
(I enjoyed every minute of today too.)

(Today I'm going to the Artificial Island
with Saotome-kun.)

Sorry, it took me a while to get ready...
Okay, let's get going!
Phew, this is a pretty nice place.
Yeah, it feels great, doesn't it?
Ahahaha.
rows.notes: Shared by both player genders, Luca, Nanase and Sheryl.

rows.en: Geez, what are you even thinking...
Man, that really felt like a resort vacation~
I'd love to come back sometime if we get the chance.
Yeah, me too.
(I enjoyed every minute of today too~)

(I'm going to the Artificial Island with Alto
again today!)

No matter how many times I come,
the ocean's great!

Yeah.
Let's have a blast today too!
Heh, you got it!

Phew... maybe I overdid it a little...
Flying is easier than this.
Hahaha, maybe so.

(I'm going to the Artificial Island with Saotome-kun
again today!)

Yeah.
Let's have a blast today too!
(Alto said he'd be "on the roof," I think...)
Oh, \p. You came?
Lost in thought on the roof again?
Hm? Yeah, something like that.
Same as ever, huh.

I've always spent a lot of time looking at the sky.
Even now, I end up gazing at it like this.
Always...? Did something get you started?

\p.
Do you have a dream?
A dream? What's this all of a sudden?

I want to see a real sky with my own eyes.
And I want to fly in it.
The sky, huh...

Yeah. Blue, stretching on forever...
The horizon, and white clouds...
A real, free sky like that...
That sounds like it'd feel amazing.

Once we reach a new planet, I can do that anytime.
Though who knows when that'll be.
I hope your dream comes true.
Yeah, someday...
When that day comes, maybe I'll fly with you.
Hmm? I don't mind, but just don't get in my way.
You've got some nerve.
Ahaha, I'm kidding.
I hope we find it soon. Our... everyone's sky...
Yeah, I hope we find it.

(I wonder if Alto has some special feelings
about the sky...)
(Saotome-kun said he'd be "on the roof," I think...)
Yeah. Lost in thought on the roof again?
Same as ever, huh.
Always...? Did something get you started?
A dream? What's this all of a sudden?
The sky, huh...
That sounds like it'd feel amazing.
I hope your dream comes true.
When that day comes, maybe I'll fly with you.
Geez, that's mean.
Yeah, I hope we find it.
